    Network & Mobile

    Local-network defaults for mobile controllers. Pairing and per-device access live in Remote Control.

    🔒

    Controllers connect over your local network

    Phones and tablets pair over the LAN with a pinned certificate — nothing is exposed to the internet.

    DEVICES

    Remote Control · Devices

    Pair phones & tablets, approve requests, and manage each controller's access.

    LAN CONTROL SERVER

    Enable mobile control

    Let paired phones and tablets control this desktop over your local network. Not configurable yet — the server is always on when the app runs.

    DISCOVERY

    Advertise on the network (mDNS)

    Let mobile apps find this desktop automatically. Not configurable yet.

    ⓘ

    On networks that block multicast, automatic discovery won't work.

    Pair by scanning the QR code on the desktop instead — see Remote Control · Devices.

    STAGE / CONFIDENCE DEFAULTS

    ◱

    The audience never sees Next, timers, TIME UP, or stage messages by default.

    TIME UP SAFETY

    🔒

    Audience outputs are excluded from TIME UP by default.

    Showing TIME UP to the audience needs an explicit per-output selection each time — this is a fixed safety invariant, not a setting.

    Default TIME UP target

    Stage / confidence only — audience excluded.

    LOCKED · STAGE ONLY

    Flash the TIME UP words

    Default is solid inverted (static high-contrast), not flashing. When flashing is on, output is capped at ≤3 flashes/sec within a small safe area — enforced by the flash-rate analyzer, always on.

    PER-OUTPUT CONFIG COMING SOON

    Each output will be able to show a different layout of the same live state: safe area, frame rate, delay, mirror, rotate, crop, scale.

    OUTPUT HEALTH COMING SOON

    Dropped-frame warning threshold and a per-output health readout will land here.

    TEST PATTERNS COMING SOON

    Sending a calibration test pattern to a chosen output will land here.

    NETWORK OUTPUTS COMING SOON

    NDI, browser-source, and alpha lower-third outputs will land here. NDI® is a registered trademark of Vizrt Group (ndi.video).

    REDUCED MOTION

    Reduced motion (audience-facing & network outputs)

    Turns off decorative motion on audience-facing outputs. Seizure-safety caps stay on regardless. Operator-UI motion is set on General. Not configurable yet.

    RELIABILITY

    Autosave

    Always on. At most 5 seconds of work is lost on a forced shutdown.

    ON · SAVES WITHIN 5s

    Crash-loop protection

    After repeated crashes in quick succession, SelahCue stops auto-resuming and asks whether to resume the last session or start clean — your previous session is preserved either way.
